name: Grant for Marriage of Daughters of Scheduled Caste Individuals
benefit: **Grant Amount:** ₹50,000/- per daughter, for the marriage of up to two daughters.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 2. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste category. 3. The family’s total monthly income from all sources must not exceed ₹4,000/-, or the family must belong to the BPL category. 4. At the time of marriage, the bride’s age must be between 18 and 45 years. 5. At the time of marriage, the groom’s age must be between 21 and 45 years. 6. The grant is applicable for the marriage of up to two daughters.
